benefits: Instant booking with automatic QRIS payments

policies.title: Terms and Conditions
items: The account information you provide must be accurate and up to date. You are responsible for keeping your password and account activity confidential.
Court availability follows the schedule shown. A booking is confirmed when the transaction status is marked successful in the app.
Use facilities according to the schedule, venue rules, and applicable safety instructions. Changes and cancellations follow the information shown during booking.
Do not use your account or the service to disrupt other users, damage facilities, or engage in unlawful activity.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
items: OBC Sport uses the name, email, and phone number you provide to create and manage your account, process bookings, and share service information.
Account information is not displayed publicly. Data is used only to operate the service and communicate about your account or bookings.
You may contact the OBC Sport administrator for help with your account information. Never share your password or security codes.
By continuing registration, you confirm that you have read the terms of service and the data-use notice above.
